content.bridge_context: Introduction to the supreme law of India.

units.title: What is a Constitution?
units.explanation: A set of rules according to which a country is governed.
units.dual_language_instruction: Why do we need rules in a game? / हमें खेल में नियमों की आवश्यकता क्यों है?

units.title: The Preamble
units.explanation: The introduction to the Constitution that states its aims and objectives.
units.dual_language_instruction: Recite the first line of the Preamble. / प्रस्तावना की पहली पंक्ति सुनाएँ।
